# The MCP tools

<p class="pm-kind"><b>Reference · generated</b> · every tool `pms-mcp` registers, with its input schema, printed by the server itself</p>

The server speaks JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio. `mesh_probe_pulse` and `mesh_reachability` are registered only when `PMS_MCP_ALLOW_PROBE=1` is set at launch.

## `mesh_list_rings`

Enumerate POSIX SHM regions that look like Pulse Mesh rings. On Linux this scans /dev/shm/pms-*; on macOS POSIX shared-memory names are not enumerable via the filesystem, so this returns an empty list with a `note` field rather than failing.

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|

## `mesh_ring_peek`

Read-only snapshot of an existing SHM-backed PulseRing. Returns capacity, write_count, cursor, and the most-recent N slot summaries. Give a hub name (e.g. default_hub) for the daemon's ring or a raw POSIX SHM name starting with /; the ring's header records its capacity and slot size, so none is passed. The reader attaches as a secondary reader — it does not advance the primary cursor.

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | integer |  | Max number of recent slots to summarize. |
| `ring_name` | string | yes | Hub name (e.g. default_hub) or a raw POSIX SHM name starting with /. |

## `codec_roundtrip`

Canonically encode a PulseEnvelope spec, round-trip decode it, and return the canonical hex + BLAKE3 content hash + size. Proves the canonical codec works for the supplied input. The same canonical_hex output is byte-identical across Rust, Python, and Node implementations of the codec, which is the byte equality the standard is built on.

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `envelope_type` | integer | yes |  |
| `payload_hex` | string |  | Hex-encoded raw payload bytes (mutually exclusive with payload_utf8). |
| `payload_utf8` | string |  | UTF-8 payload bytes (mutually exclusive with payload_hex). |
| `type_name` | string |  |  |

## `mesh_envelope_describe`

Decode a canonical PulseEnvelope hex string and return a structural summary: envelope_type, content_hash, monotonic_nanos, flags, payload variant + size. Pure function — does not touch live mesh state.

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `canonical_hex` | string | yes | Canonical wire bytes, lowercase hex. |

## `modules_list`

List the M01..M12 optimization modules, optionally filtered to one developer profile (hft / ai / robotics / telemetry / dev). Each entry includes its M-id, crate name, one-line summary, and the profiles it is recommended for.

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `profile` | string |  | Optional profile filter. one of ["hft","ai","robotics","telemetry","dev"] |

## `modules_describe`

Describe one M01..M12 optimization module by its M-id: the crate or module that implements it, its one-line summary, and the developer profiles it is recommended for. The implementing crate's rustdoc carries the full documentation.

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Module id like 'M04'. |

## `mesh_attach`

Register a process name in the mesh-hub registry. Returns the daemon's assigned node_id. The connection is dropped at the end of the call; another call (or the dev-functions Rust crate) holds the name persistently if you need that.

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Process-visible name to register under. |

## `mesh_send`

Publish an envelope to a channel on the mesh-hub daemon. Returns the daemon's envelope_id.

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `as_name` | string |  | Name to attach under for this send. Defaults to 'mcp-send'. |
| `channel` | string | yes | Routing key. |
| `payload` | string |  | UTF-8 payload (use payload_hex for binary). |
| `payload_hex` | string |  | Hex-encoded payload bytes; mutually exclusive with payload. |
| `type_name` | string |  | Optional type name for typed schemas. |

## `mesh_query`

Structured query against the daemon's basket SQLite store. Returns rows or aggregations; never a firehose. Supply filters (channel, type, origin, time window) + optional aggregation (count, count_by_channel, time_bucket, distinct_channels, distinct_types). Replaces unbounded mesh_tap streaming.

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `aggregate` | string |  |  one of ["count","count_by_channel","time_bucket","distinct_channels","distinct_types"] |
| `basket_path` | string |  | Path to the basket DB. Defaults to $PMS_BASKET_DB or ~/.local/share/pms/basket.db. |
| `bucket_secs` | integer |  | Required when aggregate=time_bucket. |
| `channel` | string |  |  |
| `envelope_type` | integer |  |  |
| `limit` | integer |  | Max rows (default 50, capped at 200 for MCP). |
| `origin` | string |  |  |
| `since_unix_nanos` | integer |  | Time-window start (inclusive). |
| `type_name` | string |  |  |
| `until_unix_nanos` | integer |  | Time-window end (exclusive). |

## `mesh_health`

Report which names are attached to the daemon and basic liveness state. For v0 this returns a static snapshot (no heartbeat protocol yet); future revisions surface NodeState from mesh-health.

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|

## `mesh_replay`

Replay envelopes from the basket back through the daemon. Useful for re-running a captured workload. WARNING: also reaches subscribers — confirm with the user before using on production-relevant channels.

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `as_name` | string |  | Name to attach under. Defaults to 'mcp-replay'. |
| `channel` | string | yes | Source channel (basket query). |
| `limit` | integer |  | Max envelopes to replay (capped at 100). |
| `since_unix_nanos` | integer |  |  |
| `target_channel` | string |  | Where to replay. Defaults to source channel. |
| `until_unix_nanos` | integer |  |  |

## `mesh_probe_pulse`

Send a single pulse to a UDP target and return send-side duration. Bounded: exactly one frame per call. Does not echo / measure RTT — that requires a peer-side echo service not shipped by default. Use this for liveness checks and to surface kernel errors (destination unreachable, etc.). Gated on PMS_MCP_ALLOW_PROBE=1 at server launch.

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `instruction` | integer |  | Pulse instruction opcode (default: Heartbeat = 1). |
| `payload_hex` | string |  | Optional hex-encoded envelope payload. Empty if omitted. |
| `target` | string | yes | UDP destination, e.g. 127.0.0.1:9000. |

## `mesh_reachability`

Send a one-pulse Heartbeat probe to each target in turn and report whether the kernel accepted the send. UDP is connectionless so this is a send-success check, not an RTT measurement. Gated on PMS_MCP_ALLOW_PROBE=1.

| Input | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `targets` | array | yes | List of UDP destinations, e.g. ["127.0.0.1:9000", "10.0.0.5:9001"]. |
